data_source: User-authorized actual iPhone Beanzen journal and coffee-only cover photographs, copied read-only previously; privacy-filtered separate working copy used. No actual iPhone data changed.
what_this_demonstrates: Native generated share images, not screenshots or recreations of a share card. Square JPEG over the original brew photo with user-selected record information.
native_navigation: Open a brew with a cover photo.
Scroll to Share image, before Delete Brew, and tap it.
Preview is generated automatically. Switch Coffee, Brewer, Grinder, Water, Tasting or Brew sections on/off.
Tap Share to open the platform share menu and choose a destination. No external destination was opened or used during these captures.

control_behavior.without_cover_photo: Share image is unavailable until a brew cover photo is attached.
control_behavior.without_section_data: The unavailable section is disabled; selecting the empty row leads back to its details.
control_behavior.regeneration: Changing a section regenerates the native preview and JPEG.
control_behavior.chart: No chart section or chart included.
control_behavior.brew_fields: Dose, weight, ratio, time and temperature where available.
control_behavior.other_fields: Coffee roaster/name/country, brewer, grinder and setting, water/TDS, tasting rating where available.

outputs.native_generator: ShareCardView → ShareRender → ShareCardPainter; completed file extracted directly from ShareFiles cache
outputs.metadata_review: Only orientation, resolution, color space and image dimensions; no GPS, author or comment tags.
